interpretation: The repeatable non-drum reduction separates further: vocals and other have lower median level in all six windows; other also has lower onset density in all six. Bass is comparatively preserved and its onset direction is split. Drums are not lower. The strongest supported reading is a retained drums-and-bass chassis with subtraction concentrated in vocal and other estimated layers, subject to separator error.
